purpose: Teach: カーボン/絶頂/アカデミック/水域/右折/前兆/全裸/盲目

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、カーボンファイバー医療器具を医療チームで採用します
lines.en: Ren, we're adopting carbon-fiber medical instruments across the team.
lines.style: Clear, steady opening. Measured pace, professional register. No filler — direct statement of fact. Shoulders back, eye-level gaze. Competent and unhurried.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者が絶頂期に病を発見する事例も医療チームで扱います
lines.en: Yes, and we also handle cases where patients discover illness at peak life stages.
lines.style: Slight pause before speaking. Warm but clinical. The tone of someone who has seen this pattern before. Gentle emphasis on 「discover」 — acknowledging the human weight of it.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、アカデミックな診断基準を医療チームで遵守します
lines.en: Ren, we maintain academic diagnostic standards across all team decisions.
lines.style: Return to calm authority. Even cadence. No apology in the voice — these are standards, not suggestions. Crisp articulation on 「standards」.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、海水浴水域での溺水救急を医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Yes, we're equipped to respond to water rescue emergencies and drowning cases.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring. Slight emphasis on 「equipped」 — not boasting, informing. Breath underneath suggests capability without fanfare. Clinical precision with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 右折車との衝突事故患者を、貴院、救急で受けられますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital does handle motor vehicle collision patients in emergency, right, Doctor?
lines.style: Tentative question dressed as affirmation. Rising slightly at the end. Respectful distance — he's checking, not assuming. Quieter than the doctor's register. Seeking confirmation rather than challenging.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、心臓発作の前兆症状を医療チームで丁寧に問診します
lines.en: Yes, our team carefully evaluates pre-heart-attack warning symptoms during intake.
lines.style: Unhurried, methodical. Weight on 「carefully」 and 「evaluate」 — this is where precision saves lives. Warm but unwavering. The voice of someone who trusts her team's attention.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 全裸での徘徊患者を、貴院、保護されますね、先生
lines.en: And your hospital does provide protective care for patients presenting with confusion or disorientation, correct, Doctor?
lines.style: More formal phrasing this time — he's building confidence. Still deferential but less wavering. Breath steadier. He's learned something from her answers. Still asking, not stating.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、盲目患者のリハビリを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes, we provide comprehensive rehabilitation for blind and visually impaired patients.
lines.style: Firm close. No diminishment in her voice — rehabilitation work matters as much as emergency response. Even tone, grounded. Final statement of capability and commitment.
